Sub 'PrintFilters'
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
If not (&TFprogCodigo.IsEmpty() AND &TFprogCodigo_To.IsEmpty()) print printBlockTFprogCodigo &TFprogCodigo_To_Description = format('%1 (%2)', "Codigo", "WWP_TSTo") print printBlockTFprogCodigo_To EndIf If not &TFprogDescricao_Sel.IsEmpty() print printBlockTFprogDescricao_Sel Else If not &TFprogDescricao.IsEmpty() print printBlockTFprogDescricao EndIf EndIf If not &TFprogSigla_Sel.IsEmpty() print printBlockTFprogSigla_Sel Else If not &TFprogSigla.IsEmpty() print printBlockTFprogSigla EndIf EndIf &TFprogApareceRemessa_Sels.FromJson(&TFprogApareceRemessa_SelsJson) If not &TFprogApareceRemessa_Sels.Count = 0 &i = 1 For &TFprogApareceRemessa_Sel in &TFprogApareceRemessa_Sels If &i = 1 &TFprogApareceRemessa_SelDscs = '' Else &TFprogApareceRemessa_SelDscs += ', ' EndIf &FilterTFprogApareceRemessa_SelValueDescription = '' Do Case Case &TFprogApareceRemessa_Sel.ToString().Trim() = !"S" &FilterTFprogApareceRemessa_SelValueDescription = "Sim"
Case &TFprogApareceRemessa_Sel.ToString().Trim() = !"N" &FilterTFprogApareceRemessa_SelValueDescription = "Não"
EndCase
&TFprogApareceRemessa_SelDscs += &FilterTFprogApareceRemessa_SelValueDescription &i += 1 EndFor print printBlockTFprogApareceRemessa_Sel EndIf &TFprogOrigem_Sels.FromJson(&TFprogOrigem_SelsJson) If not &TFprogOrigem_Sels.Count = 0 &i = 1 For &TFprogOrigem_Sel in &TFprogOrigem_Sels If &i = 1 &TFprogOrigem_SelDscs = '' Else &TFprogOrigem_SelDscs += ', ' EndIf &FilterTFprogOrigem_SelValueDescription = '' Do Case Case &TFprogOrigem_Sel.ToString().Trim() = !"U" &FilterTFprogOrigem_SelValueDescription = "Federeal"
Case &TFprogOrigem_Sel.ToString().Trim() = !"E" &FilterTFprogOrigem_SelValueDescription = "Estadual"
Case &TFprogOrigem_Sel.ToString().Trim() = !"M" &FilterTFprogOrigem_SelValueDescription = "Municipal"
EndCase
&TFprogOrigem_SelDscs += &FilterTFprogOrigem_SelValueDescription &i += 1 EndFor print printBlockTFprogOrigem_Sel EndIf &TFproTipoLicitacao_Sels.FromJson(&TFproTipoLicitacao_SelsJson) If not &TFproTipoLicitacao_Sels.Count = 0 &i = 1 For &TFproTipoLicitacao_Sel in &TFproTipoLicitacao_Sels If &i = 1 &TFproTipoLicitacao_SelDscs = '' Else &TFproTipoLicitacao_SelDscs += ', ' EndIf &FilterTFproTipoLicitacao_SelValueDescription = '' Do Case Case &TFproTipoLicitacao_Sel.ToString().Trim() = !"G" &FilterTFproTipoLicitacao_SelValueDescription = "Geral"
Case &TFproTipoLicitacao_Sel.ToString().Trim() = !"E" &FilterTFproTipoLicitacao_SelValueDescription = "Específica"
EndCase
&TFproTipoLicitacao_SelDscs += &FilterTFproTipoLicitacao_SelValueDescription &i += 1 EndFor print printBlockTFproTipoLicitacao_Sel EndIf &TFprogStatus_Sels.FromJson(&TFprogStatus_SelsJson) If not &TFprogStatus_Sels.Count = 0 &i = 1 For &TFprogStatus_Sel in &TFprogStatus_Sels If &i = 1 &TFprogStatus_SelDscs = '' Else &TFprogStatus_SelDscs += ', ' EndIf &FilterTFprogStatus_SelValueDescription = '' Do Case Case &TFprogStatus_Sel.ToString().Trim() = !"A" &FilterTFprogStatus_SelValueDescription = "Ativo"
Case &TFprogStatus_Sel.ToString().Trim() = !"I" &FilterTFprogStatus_SelValueDescription = "Intivo"
EndCase
&TFprogStatus_SelDscs += &FilterTFprogStatus_SelValueDescription &i += 1 EndFor print printBlockTFprogStatus_Sel EndIf
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */
EndSub

Sub 'PrintData'
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
For each trnsprogramas order progDescricao when &OrderedBy = 1 AND &OrderedDsc = False order (progDescricao) when &OrderedBy = 1 AND &OrderedDsc = True order progCodigo when &OrderedBy = 2 AND &OrderedDsc = False order (progCodigo) when &OrderedBy = 2 AND &OrderedDsc = True order progSigla when &OrderedBy = 3 AND &OrderedDsc = False order (progSigla) when &OrderedBy = 3 AND &OrderedDsc = True order progApareceRemessa when &OrderedBy = 4 AND &OrderedDsc = False order (progApareceRemessa) when &OrderedBy = 4 AND &OrderedDsc = True order progOrigem when &OrderedBy = 5 AND &OrderedDsc = False order (progOrigem) when &OrderedBy = 5 AND &OrderedDsc = True order proTipoLicitacao when &OrderedBy = 6 AND &OrderedDsc = False order (proTipoLicitacao) when &OrderedBy = 6 AND &OrderedDsc = True order progStatus when &OrderedBy = 7 AND &OrderedDsc = False order (progStatus) when &OrderedBy = 7 AND &OrderedDsc = True
using trnsprogramasWWDS(&TFprogCodigo, &TFprogCodigo_To, &TFprogDescricao, &TFprogDescricao_Sel, &TFprogSigla, &TFprogSigla_Sel , &TFprogApareceRemessa_Sels, &TFprogOrigem_Sels, &TFproTipoLicitacao_Sels, &TFprogStatus_Sels) &progApareceRemessaDescription = '' Do Case Case progApareceRemessa.ToString().Trim() = !"S" &progApareceRemessaDescription = "Sim"
Case progApareceRemessa.ToString().Trim() = !"N" &progApareceRemessaDescription = "Não"
EndCase &progOrigemDescription = '' Do Case Case progOrigem.ToString().Trim() = !"U" &progOrigemDescription = "Federeal"
Case progOrigem.ToString().Trim() = !"E" &progOrigemDescription = "Estadual"
Case progOrigem.ToString().Trim() = !"M" &progOrigemDescription = "Municipal"
EndCase &proTipoLicitacaoDescription = '' Do Case Case proTipoLicitacao.ToString().Trim() = !"G" &proTipoLicitacaoDescription = "Geral"
Case proTipoLicitacao.ToString().Trim() = !"E" &proTipoLicitacaoDescription = "Específica"
EndCase &progStatusDescription = '' Do Case Case progStatus.ToString().Trim() = !"A" &progStatusDescription = "Ativo"
Case progStatus.ToString().Trim() = !"I" &progStatusDescription = "Intivo"
EndCase
Do 'BeforePrintLine' print printBlockLines_data Do 'AfterPrintLine' EndFor
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */
EndSub
Sub 'LoadGridState'
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
// Load grid state from session. If &Session.Get(!"trnsprogramasWWGridState") = !"" &GridState.FromXml(LoadGridState.Udp(!"trnsprogramasWWGridState")) Else &GridState.FromXml(&Session.Get(!"trnsprogramasWWGridState")) Endif
&OrderedBy = &GridState.OrderedBy &OrderedDsc = &GridState.OrderedDsc
For &GridStateFilterValue in &GridState.FilterValues Do Case Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFPROGCODIGO" &TFprogCodigo.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value) &TFprogCodigo_To.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.ValueTo) Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFPROGDESCRICAO" &TFprogDescricao.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value) Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFPROGDESCRICAO_SEL" &TFprogDescricao_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value) Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFPROGSIGLA" &TFprogSigla.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value) Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFPROGSIGLA_SEL" &TFprogSigla_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value) Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFPROGAPARECEREMESSA_SEL" &TFprogApareceRemessa_SelsJson = &GridStateFilterValue.Value &TFprogApareceRemessa_Sels.FromJson(&TFprogApareceRemessa_SelsJson) Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFPROGORIGEM_SEL" &TFprogOrigem_SelsJson = &GridStateFilterValue.Value &TFprogOrigem_Sels.FromJson(&TFprogOrigem_SelsJson) Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFPROTIPOLICITACAO_SEL" &TFproTipoLicitacao_SelsJson = &GridStateFilterValue.Value &TFproTipoLicitacao_Sels.FromJson(&TFproTipoLicitacao_SelsJson) Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFPROGSTATUS_SEL" &TFprogStatus_SelsJson = &GridStateFilterValue.Value &TFprogStatus_Sels.FromJson(&TFprogStatus_SelsJson) EndCase EndFor
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */
EndSub
